scope: Local S3 API/PostgreSQL load with 100 synthetic services and 10000 deployment histories; log rendering and real workload execution have separate evidence.

process.transport: HTTP loopback to a production Node process; no TLS proxy or public RTT
process.instrumentation: 1 Hz process.cpuUsage/memoryUsage over IPC; no product metrics endpoint

limits: Developer machine, not Oracle or the 2-core/12-GB target.
Service metadata is created through the API against synthetic cluster identity fixtures; synthetic failed histories are seeded directly only in the disposable schema and are never queued.
No Kubernetes/SSH/build/rollout, log-window or model-provider workload.
At most 20 diagnostic tasks per client exercise durable acceptance; no Worker executes this disposable schema. Queue execution/recovery is tested separately.
The isolated schema has no Worker heartbeat; a degraded queue observation does not constitute a Redis fault test.
CPU/RSS describe the isolated API process, excluding the driver, PostgreSQL, Redis and Worker.
Pool wait time and per-query timing are not instrumented; database connection snapshots are database-wide.

databaseConnectionsBefore.scope: whole database; includes other idle local applications and the baseline driver

methodology.concurrency: closed-loop; five clients by default, each has at most one request in flight
methodology.workload: 20% service lists, 20% service details, 30% deployment lists, 10% deployment details, 10% service PATCH, 10% operation list/limited diagnostic admission. Five closed-loop clients by default.
methodology.percentile: nearest rank, computed from every observed request; no automatic retries or excluded failures
methodology.serverLatency: API production onResponse durationMs, rounded to milliseconds; correlated by synthetic request ID
methodology.clientLatency: loopback fetch through complete JSON response; includes local transport and driver scheduling
methodology.cpu: process.cpuUsage user + system microseconds divided by elapsed wall time; 100% equals one CPU core
methodology.rss: process.memoryUsage.rss sampled each second and at stop; peak is the largest observed sample

databaseConnectionsAfter.scope: whole database; includes other idle local applications and the baseline driver
